text:
Fabian Zetterlund has become a fixture beside Tim Stützle and Dylan Cozens since William Eklund went down, and the line has been the engine of an eight-game point streak. The Hockey Writers said he is running away with the opportunity. The numbers back the play: Ottawa takes 63% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on (expected goals measure the quality of chances), 12 points better than without him.

The finish is the missing piece. He has two goals on 5.6 expected and 11 points in 24 games. Goals tend to follow chances like that. He also throws his weight around, 53 hits, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking shows a dump-and-chase player, carrying the puck in on only 33% of entries. Off the ice, his gesture for a cousin with leukemia made a Senators night special. Our range has him around 15 goals.
